decisions.reason: Having remained in the range after launch and fitting the firm's modular sensing platform, this sensor module is likely to be retained unless sales are clearly below expectations.
This industrial AC voltage input module sits very close to the firm's core automation hardware business and therefore has a very low likelihood of withdrawal.
The solid state relay module is a standard complement to control and automation installations, so it is likely to stay as part of the broader building-block portfolio.

The server room monitoring kit is more application-specific than the core modules, but it still leverages the firm's platform and can remain attractive while the firm expands solution-oriented offers.
The RGB LED control module broadens the modular electronics ecosystem and is likely to be kept, though its more niche use makes it somewhat more exposed than core industrial I/O products.
The remote access service for wallboxes aligns well with the firm's stated push into charging, load management and energy management, making continuation the more likely choice.
